function.name: bash
function.description: Run a shell command in the current working directory and capture its output.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait before killing the command.

function.name: read
function.description: Read a text file and return its lines.

file_path.description: Path of the file to read.

offset.description: Zero-based line index to start reading from.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

function.name: write
function.description: Write text to a file, creating parent directories and overwriting any existing content.

file_path.description: Path of the file to write.

content.description: The full text content to write.

function.name: edit
function.description: Replace an exact string in a file with a new string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents for a regular expression.

pattern.description: The regular expression to search for.

path.description: Directory (searched recursively) or single file to search.

glob.description: Filename glob used to filter files when path is a directory.

include.description: Alias for glob (filename glob used to filter files).

function.name: glob
function.description: Find files whose paths match a glob pattern.

path.description: The base directory to search from.

function.name: webfetch
function.description: Fetch a URL over HTTP(S) and return its (truncated) text content.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the response.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters of the body to return.

function.name: skill
function.description: Load a skill: return the SKILL.md instructions of .agents/skills/<name>.

name.description: The skill name, i.e. its directory under .agents/skills.

function.name: todowrite
function.description: Replace the session's todo list with todos (pure agent bookkeeping).

todos.description: The new todo list; every item carries content and status.

function.name: task
function.description: Hand prompt to a nested agent and return its final report.

description.description: Short description of the delegated task.

prompt.description: The full instruction handed to the nested agent.
